stages.name: instagram-publish-canonicalization
stages.rollback: Restore prior publication authorities/runtime choke-point wiring; keep exact preflight and receipt verification fail-closed.

stages.name: sensor-shadow-selection
stages.rollback: Disable selector and run FULL_SUITE; registry remains metadata only.

stages.name: required-fast-and-affected-ci
stages.rollback: Revert workflow/ruleset activation; affected selector can fall back to FULL_SUITE.

stages.name: critical-external-effect-framework
stages.rollback: Return callers to existing channel-specific gates; keep policy registry references.

stages.name: agents-locality
stages.rollback: Restore moved guide lines from git history if locality change breaks routing; no business-state migration.

stages.name: visible-text-and-readme-locality
stages.rollback: Return to current global Visible Text + README gates while preserving exact artifact receipts.

stages.name: operational-debt-and-retention
stages.rollback: Stop movers/cleanup; retain Git artifacts and current schedules. No deletion is required for rollback.

stages.name: core-instance-separation
stages.rollback: Keep compatibility reads/writes and revert callers to legacy locations; no big-bang cutover.

stages.name: deprecation-and-acceptance
stages.rollback: Restore deprecated readers only if acceptance evidence fails; final deletion still requires explicit authorization.

global_rollback_rules: No force push or history rewrite.
Preserve exact-action receipts and provider verification evidence.
Selection/affected CI must fail broad to FULL_SUITE on unknowns.
Artifact migration remains copy-first until verification; Stage 0 authorizes no deletion.
Policy semantics remain in current authority until the target stage explicitly migrates them.
